t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to choose gnomes that are on the red end of the colour scheme rather than blue and green (so choose 'warn' colours)

vb_textbox.text: Generally colours that veer towards red seem better (purple, red). There is one combination with pink and a red/brown, in this instance I would pick pink. Also I'm undecided between orange and green, they worked equally well for me.
